subject: planner: avoid string type's collate affecting predicate simplification (#62141)
summary: Reviewed the change to `pkg/planner/core/rule_predicate_simplification.go` (OR-branch elimination via `unsatisfiable`) which now skips constant-substitution simplification when string constant collations are incompatible with the target column collation, preventing collation_connection-dependent simplification outcomes (covered by new gbk_bin integration test). No Blocker/High correctness/semantics issues found in the change relative to its first parent.
